database_contract.wal_boundary: All 18 sidecars were absent in planning. If any exists at execution, even zero-byte, STOP before SQL. Do not use immutable mode to ignore a present WAL/journal. No alternate reader, copying or retries.
database_contract.open: stdlib sqlite3.connect(Path.as_uri() + '?mode=ro&immutable=1', uri=True, timeout=0.0); connection-local PRAGMA query_only=ON. Install an authorizer denying writes, transactions, ATTACH/DETACH, extension loading and all non-allowlisted actions; no load_extension or user functions. Only SELECT/READ and the specified read-only table_info pragma are allowed after query_only is set.
database_contract.schema_query: SELECT name, type, sql FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type IN ('table','view') ORDER BY name LIMIT 129
database_contract.schema_selection: These complete table names were observed in current pinned schema source. Query only an exact allowlisted name actually present as an ordinary table. A missing table is explicit diagnostic data, not fabricated empty rows. A view/virtual table is not executed. No prefix matching or guessed truncated source-literal table names.
database_contract.identifier_quoting: Only the fixed allowlist names above are eligible; quote SQL identifiers with double quotes and doubled embedded quotes. Never interpolate data as SQL.
database_contract.representation: Retain exact scalar values and text within bounds; represent BLOBs by type/length/SHA only, explicitly content not inspected. Do not JSON.parse nested payload strings as a precondition. If row/field/output/progress bounds are exceeded, preserve bounded collected evidence and named incompleteness; no successful complete-diagnostic assertion, paging, retry or cap increase.
database_contract.cleanup: Close every opened connection in finally. After closing, rehash all six DBs and check all 18 sidecars still absent; compare all 27 current sources and immutable raw inputs. Record every opened/closed connection and exception. A failed query is not retried and does not authorize a repair.
